purpose: Qualify Open-Meteo Historical Weather API as a point-query transport for ERA5 2m temperature/dewpoint/VPD, before reading any frog response endpoint.

source.reference: Earthmover public Icechunk ERA5 single/temporal t2m and d2m

sample: 12 deterministic eligible NAAMP runs selected by the smallest SHA256(RunID) values among runs with complete ten stops, valid survey date and parseable StartTime/EndTime.
location: Mean latitude/longitude of the run's ten physical SiteID coordinates, mapped to the nearest 0.25-degree ERA5 cell for the Earthmover reference.
time: Local survey midpoint converted to UTC with timezonefinder; compare nearest ERA5 valid_time hour. If midpoint is exactly half-hour, ties round to the earlier hour.

validation.openmeteo_multi_coordinate_shape: A two-coordinate, one-day request must return two point responses with hourly arrays.
validation.grid_cell: Open-Meteo returned grid coordinate must be within 0.13 degrees of the Earthmover nearest ERA5 cell.
validation.pass: All 12 comparisons pass temperature, dewpoint and cell tolerances; API VPD agrees with VPD recalculated from Open-Meteo temperature/dewpoint within tolerance.
